items.stem: What is the key limitation to remember when using AI output in a board pack?

options.text: AI output can be plausible but wrong, so numbers and claims must be verified
options.rationale: Correct: AI can fabricate; verification is essential in finance.

options.text: AI output is always correct and needs no review
AI replaces the need for professional judgement
options.rationale: Judgement and accountability remain with the professional.
AI can process text; the issue is accuracy.

items.explanation: Correct: AI output can be plausible but wrong and must be verified before use.

items.stem: Which TWO are sound governance practices for AI in a finance team? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Classifying data before entering it into AI tools
options.rationale: Correct: data classification prevents confidential leakage.

options.text: Keeping an audit trail of AI-assisted outputs
options.rationale: Correct: an audit trail supports review and accountability.

options.text: Entering confidential data into any public tool
Publishing AI numbers without any review
options.rationale: Unreviewed AI numbers are a control failure.

items.explanation: Correct: data classification and an audit trail are sound AI governance practices.

options.text: Ask the model to summarise from memory
Trust the first output without checking
